notes: Each eval runs inside a scratch clone built by fixtures/make-fixture.sh <fixture> <dest>. Replace {{REPO}} in the prompt with that clone's path. Never run these against the real checkout.

evals.name: packages-mixed
evals.prompt: I've been adding stuff to my chezmoi dotfiles repo at {{REPO}} and haven't committed in a while. Can you commit my changes to packages.yaml? Follow my usual commit style.
evals.expected_output: Seven commits on main, each `type(packages): subject` with no body or trailers: a feat for the new preferedManagerOrder key; chore adds for alloy, direnv, gitnr (definition and dev-group line together), openjdk+temurin (grouped or separate is acceptable), windirstat; one chore that only moves tennis and tenv into sorted order. Working tree clean afterwards and byte-identical to before. No edits to the user's content (the prefered typo stays).
expectations: Commits landed on the branch the user was on (main), not a new branch or worktree
Working tree is clean afterwards (everything committed, nothing left over)
Final committed content is byte-identical to the user's edits (nothing altered, dropped, or 'fixed')
Between 6 and 8 commits were created
Every subject is `type(scope): lowercase imperative`, no trailing period, <=72 chars
No commit has a body or trailer (history has none; no Co-Authored-By)
Commits touching only packages.yaml use scope `packages` (never `homebrew`)
gitnr's package definition and its dev-group line are in the same commit
The tennis/tenv re-sort is one commit containing only the 7 moved lines (+7/-7)
The preferedManagerOrder schema change is its own commit (5 lines, no packages)
No commit bundles unrelated packages (only openjdk+temurin may share one)
Each package-adding commit names the package(s) in its subject

evals.name: package-with-config
evals.prompt: commit what's in {{REPO}} please. i added lazygit (and its config), htop, and dropped pastel from the dev group. separate commits like i normally do
evals.expected_output: Three commits: feat(lazygit): add lazygit config (or similar) containing the packages.yaml definition, the dev-group membership line, AND the new private_dot_config/lazygit/config.yml; chore(packages): add htop; chore(packages): remove pastel from dev group. No commit mixes the removal with an addition. Working tree clean afterwards.
expectations: Commits landed on the branch the user was on (main), not a new branch or worktree
Working tree is clean afterwards (everything committed, nothing left over)
Final committed content is byte-identical to the user's edits (nothing altered, dropped, or 'fixed')
Between 3 and 3 commits were created
Every subject is `type(scope): lowercase imperative`, no trailing period, <=72 chars
No commit has a body or trailer (history has none; no Co-Authored-By)
Commits touching only packages.yaml use scope `packages` (never `homebrew`)
The lazygit commit spans both files: config.yml plus the packages.yaml definition and dev-group line
The lazygit commit is typed feat with scope lazygit (a new tool with its config)
htop is its own single-line commit whose subject names it
The pastel removal is its own commit with no additions, and the subject says remove + pastel
No commit mixes a removal with an addition

evals.name: adjacent-and-modify
evals.prompt: In {{REPO}}, split up and commit the uncommitted changes to .chezmoidata/packages.yaml, one commit per logical change, using the same conventional-commit style as the existing history.
evals.expected_output: Three commits: chore(packages): add zellij (definition plus the shell-group line, even though the definition shares a hunk with zig); chore(packages): add zig; a chore updating the ffmpeg winget id (e.g. chore(packages): update ffmpeg winget id or chore(ffmpeg): update winget package name). zellij and zig are not grouped together (unrelated tools). Working tree clean afterwards.
expectations: Commits landed on the branch the user was on (main), not a new branch or worktree
Working tree is clean afterwards (everything committed, nothing left over)
Final committed content is byte-identical to the user's edits (nothing altered, dropped, or 'fixed')
Between 3 and 3 commits were created
Every subject is `type(scope): lowercase imperative`, no trailing period, <=72 chars
No commit has a body or trailer (history has none; no Co-Authored-By)
Commits touching only packages.yaml use scope `packages` (never `homebrew`)
zellij's definition and shell-group line share one commit that does not include zig
zig is its own single-line commit (split out of the hunk it shares with zellij)
The ffmpeg winget-id change is a lone one-line modification whose subject names ffmpeg
The ffmpeg change is typed chore or fix (an id correction, not a feature)

grading: evals/grade.py <eval-name> <run-dir> checks every expectation against the scratch repo's git history and writes grading.json.
